comments.text: The Nile has sustained life in Egypt for thousands of years, and it’s remarkable how much still depends on that river today. Beyond the monuments and tourist attractions, I’d love to understand more about how ordinary Egyptians navigate daily life, preserve their traditions, and keep moving forward despite the hardships.
